risk.summary: Inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (302.6) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and FOMC event just occurred—utilities face headwinds despite defensive characteristics.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA/SMA bullish alignment (50/200) combined with extreme fear sentiment (15/100) and contrarian buy signal create asymmetric risk-reward if macro stabilizes, with support at 65.80 providing defined downside.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe short-term weakness (price below all short-term EMAs/SMAs, three black crows, negative MACD/CMF/OBV), crisis-level VIX (302.6), inverted yield curve, and zero fundamental conviction make this a high-probability false-bottom trap in a macro-deteriorating environment.
